4. World Almanac/NPCs/Hesper Crane.md: Hired Ascendency handler running the Cinderworks depot for Marrow; her ledger pointed the party to Duskferry's 'Tallyman' (S45).
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ireena Kolyana (CO: Ismark's adopted sister and Izek's lost sister, carrying Tatyana's soul; Strahd hunted her as his bride.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ismark Kolyanovich: Burgomaster of the Village of Barovia and Ireena's adoptive brother, long sworn against Strahd.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Izek Strazni (COS): Ireena's brother, his arm the Hand of Vecna; ran Vecna's works at Greyfen Hollow until the party freed him (S49).
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Kasimir Velikov (C: Last of Barovia's dusk elves, a watcher at the Amber Temple seeking a way to restore his sister Patrina.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Kiril Stoyanovich: Dead former leader of the Children of Mother Night, a cruel werewolf and Strahd's enforcer; Emil replaced him.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lady Fiona Wachter: Head of House Wachter and Vallaki's secret devil cult, Baron Vallakovich's rival; now captured at Vallaki.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lady Lydia Petrovn: Baron Vallakovich's anxiously cheerful wife, Father Lucian's sister, and Victor's mother.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lief Lipsiege (COS: Strahd's accountant, chained to a desk in Castle Ravenloft's records room, caring only for his ledgers.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lord Caldris Velmo: Athenaeum Councilor of Enchantment who built the smuggling ring Marrow stole while impersonating him; freed by the party, wants revenge.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ludmilla Vilisevic: Dead vampire-spawn bride of Strahd, once dormant near his coffin in Castle Ravenloft's catacombs.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Luvash (COS).md: Arabelle's brutal father, co-leader of the Vallaki Vistani camp with his brother Arrigal; sworn to Strahd.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Mab.md: Queen of Air and Darkness, ruler of the Gloaming Court; collecting on her bargain with Baba Lysaga.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Mad Mary (COS).md: Gertruda's grief-stricken mother in the Village of Barovia, barricaded in her townhouse since Gertruda vanished; met S10.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Madam Eva (COS).md: Ageless Vistani seer at Tser Pool and Strahd's secret half-sister; traded her youth to Mother Night for foresight.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Magister Kaelor St: The Umbral Athenaeum's dwarf Councilor of Evocation, a bold battle-magic instructor training mages to defend Bruokdon.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Majesto (COS).md: Fiona Wachter's hidden imp familiar at Wachterhaus, used as proof of her cult's infernal favor.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Marrow.md: Dead doppelganger leader of the Ascendency's Bruokdon cell who impersonated Velmont, Gousse, and Roark; Faerah killed it (S44).
Disgraced half-elf historian and the Trickster God's agent, protecting Roark and tracking how knowledge of Vecna changes; met S39.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Marzena Belview (C: Paranoid mongrelfolk Belview chained in the Abbey of Saint Markovia's courtyard; only her brother Clovin can feed her.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Milivoj (COS).md: Gravedigger at Vallaki's St. Andral's Church who told Henrik Van Der Voort where the saint's bones lay; met S6.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Mishka Belview (CO: Feral mongrelfolk Belview lurking in the Abbey of Saint Markovia's courtyard well, killing whoever looks in.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Mistress Lyssandra: The Umbral Athenaeum's tiefling Councilor of Illusion; Ascendency agents held her captive after Corwin Vantor's handoff was ambushed (S44).
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Morgantha (COS).md: Night hag of Old Bonegrinder whose coven bakes dream pastries from children's bones; spies on Ravenloft through Cyrus Belview.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Naerissa.md: Elder of Duskferry's dusk elves and Eilistraee shrine-keeper; Faerah's sister guided her out of the Underdark.
